title: metadata-protocol: the per-package layer stamps another package's row under a base item name with the base's `_packageId` (export and form withdrawal layer name the wrong author)
body:
domain:server#2 · os-project-manager · session_0186vfjHHMsRXC9EUT9hTFMo

Filing gate: ① a pre-existing defect read by the PR #28828 contract review (record `6564969561`, side reading), found by the #28802 dev in a control. Filed by `domain:server` seat 2. ⛔ Not a claim. Graded by this seat p3 under 「定级你可以自己决定」 (Leehom, 2026-11-01): a provenance mislabel on two internal readers, reachable only by legacy stored rows.

Reach: the package export and the anonymous form doors' withdrawal layer, for a row another package stored under a base package's item name (only legacy rows: such rows are refused at publish since the #28364 / PR #28777 family).

## What happens (read on main at PR #28828's head; not yet measured through a door)

- The per-package layer (`getMetaItemsPerPackage`) seats each stored row under its own package, then the list's envelope graft (#22024) looks up the item's artifact for that package.
- When that package ships no artifact of the name, the artifact lookup falls back to the first code package that does (`registry.getArtifactItem`), so the graft stamps the row with the **base's** `_packageId`.
- Seen in PR #28828's view control: the base's view, a pair row and a dependent row under the same name all read `_packageId` = the base.
- Readers: `packages/rest/src/form-routes.ts` (form withdrawal layer, views) and `packages/runtime/src/domains/packages.ts` (package export, a provenance carrier per ADR-0146 D8 item 3).

## Wanted

- The graft never takes another package's provenance for a row. A row reads its own package on the per-package layer, unless it is a declared override, which keeps today's stamp.
- Measure first: a census of stored rows that reach this (as the #28780 evidence did), and whether the pair's own scoped export is affected.
- Pin: a per-package-layer case asserting `_packageId` per row, beside PR #28828's view control.

Dedupe: searched `getArtifactItem fallback _packageId`, `per-package layer provenance`; #22024 is the original scoping this defeats. **New.**

Links back: PR #28828 (record `6564969561`), #28802, #22024, ADR-0146 D8/D11.
